label: Foundational beings are necessary at w, from esse distinct from essence in contingents
meaning: B6's verdict at the foundational case. A foundational f exists at w with represented esse equal to its essence; were it absent at an accessible world it would be contingent, and B6 (every contingent being has esse distinct from essence) would contradict that identity. Only actuality and esse = essence are used.

strong_version_needed.ee4ab504-c8fe-59bc-bc96-7cbeefed6410: The proof applies excluded middle to propositions outside LocalLogic's scope, e.g. `F.history.ontic.ExistsAt v f`. LocalLogic (ca432e24) decides only whether an actual bearer is identical with a GOD_4 candidate, and gives double-negation elimination for that candidate's esse–essence identity.
